subject: input correlation and std. dev. matrices?

messages.author: b40b733c4b3d58f4
messages.subject: input correlation and std. dev. matrices?
parts:
Dear All,

As in the good ‘ol LISREL days, is it possible to input a correlation matrix and then a standard deviation matrix into lavaan, and have it compute the covariance matrix from those two matrices? I know and understand that you can input the lower half of the variance-covariance matrix, and I know how to hand convert correlations into covariance. As such, this is more of a curiosity question than anything else.

Thanks in advance for your help,
Bob Vandenberg

Sent from my iPad

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: input correlation and std. dev. matrices?
parts:
On 2/7/23 19:12, Robert Vandenberg wrote:
> As in the good ‘ol LISREL days, is it possible to input a correlation
> matrix and then a standard deviation matrix into lavaan, and have it
> compute the covariance matrix from those two matrices?

Not directly in the sem/lavaan function. But lavaan provides the
convenience function getCov() (see ?getCov) that will construct the
covariance matrix from a correlation matrix and a vector of standard
deviations.

Yves.
